summary: During the tier0 activation window of the release it runs from (soak_state activating, before activation_deadline_epoch, current == its own release), the root guardian starts or replaces its supervisors directly instead of proposing the restore to the AI gate; and tier0 promote no longer makes a release that never passed its soak (activating, activation_failed, running, failed_no_lkg) the last-known-good.
reason: S24 01/11 22:28 and 22:35 (first deploy after the OpenClaw 2026.10.9 switch): companion-deploy 3543780d and its rollback both ended activation_readiness_failed (receipt rollback_failed / runtime_sync_failed) although the Gateway restart itself succeeded (1 target, adopted). The AI gate, whose model answers through the Gateway the deploy restarts, refused the incident-orchestrator restore; the guardian only started it once the gate became unreachable, after the 120 s readiness window (rollback: 12 s late). The rollback promotion then linked last-known-good to the 3543780d release that had just failed activation.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the previous commit with companion-deploy.sh; promotions then depend again on the AI gate answering within 120 s and a failed release can again become last-known-good.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-root-guardian-gate.py (ci.yml)
tests.evidence: 10 tests: missing supervisor started and previous-release supervisor replaced during this release's activation with zero gate calls; expired window, running/activation_failed state, other release and unreadable state keep the gate; S24 capture replayed; the 2 new activation tests fail on the previous guardian.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-tier0-activation-readiness.py (ci.yml)
tests.evidence: 20 tests: promotion over a release in activating/activation_failed/running/failed_no_lkg keeps the confirmed LKG (4 subtests fail on the previous tier0-control), a stable release still becomes LKG.

capabilities.reason: Deployment/activation owner repair only; no agent, voice or app capability is added or changed.

architecture.reason: Same root guardian, same tier0 control and state file; the guardian only reads tier0 state.json, bounded by the existing 120 s activation window. No new store, daemon, scheduler or retry.

limitations: The S24 last-known-good link written by the 22:35 promotion must be repaired once by hand (owner action, recorded in S24 memory); this change only prevents it from recurring.
Outside an activation window the guardian keeps proposing restores to the AI gate, unchanged.
